name: Sandworm — Young (under 50 m)

signatureAttacks.name: Circling
signatureAttacks.text: Surfaces nearby. Everyone on sand: MOVE (D2) or 2 Stress as the ground heaves.

signatureAttacks.name: Strike from Below
signatureAttacks.text: Takes the loudest target or vehicle: MOVE (D3) to leap clear or be swallowed.

signatureAttacks.name: Lost Interest
signatureAttacks.text: Dives and leaves, unless something keeps drumming.

special: A young worm still curious about every rhythm on the sand. Fast and easily drawn by machinery.
tactics: Circles once, then strikes from below at the loudest target.
notes: Can be ridden by experts with maker hooks. A thumper turns it aside for a few minutes.

name: Sandworm — Grown (100–200 m)

signatureAttacks.name: The Mouth Opens
signatureAttacks.text: Everything in one zone is engulfed. Survivors need MOVE (D3).

signatureAttacks.name: Sand Wave
signatureAttacks.text: Every zone suffers 3 Stress as dunes collapse.

special: The size of a harvester’s shadow. It surfaces under whatever made the noise and swallows it whole.
tactics: Cannot be fought, only avoided. It arrives a set number of rounds after worm sign.

effects.text: Shields on open sand halve the time before it arrives

notes: A crawler takes about ten minutes to be eaten; plan the carryall lift accordingly.

name: Sandworm — Old Man of the Desert (400 m+)
special: A worm so large the Fremen give it a name. Its passage is felt as a tremor for kilometres.
tactics: Treat as an environmental event: every zone becomes hazardous.
notes: Its appearance is a scene in itself. Fremen characters may treat it as an omen worth any risk.

name: Sardaukar Squad

signatureAttacks.name: Lasgun Volley
signatureAttacks.text: 5 Stress to one target at long range (never fired near shields).

signatureAttacks.name: Blade Line
signatureAttacks.text: 5 Stress to every character in their zone; they do not break.

special: Six to eight terror troopers working as one body. They do not retreat, bargain, or take prisoners unless ordered.
tactics: Pin with lasguns, close with blades, never break formation.
notes: Treat as a single adversary that inflicts Stress on everyone it engages. Only trickery, terrain or rank stops them.

name: Harkonnen Troopers
special: Industrial soldiers paid by the head. Brutal and numerous but quick to break when their officer falls.
tactics: Flood a zone; burn anything that hides.
notes: Spend 1 Threat to add another squad at the edge of the scene.

name: Harkonnen Assassin

stats.test: UNDERSTAND + TRUTH to spot; BATTLE + DUTY to stop

signatureAttacks.name: Shigawire
signatureAttacks.text: 4 Stress, +2 if the victim was unaware.

special: Patient, paid, and usually already inside the household as a servant, guard or guest.
tactics: Poison first, shigawire second, a blade only if cornered.
notes: If exposed, would rather die than talk.

name: Hunter-Seeker

stats.test: DISCIPLINE + FAITH (stay still) or BATTLE + DUTY (snatch it)

signatureAttacks.name: Strike
signatureAttacks.text: Hits the moving target nearest the operator’s focus: 5 Stress and POISONED.

special: A needle-thin poisoned drone steered from nearby by an operator who watches through its eye.
tactics: Waits for movement, then strikes the throat.
notes: Freezing in place buys time; finding the operator ends the threat. Shields slow it but do not stop it.

name: Spice Blow

stats.test: UNDERSTAND + TRUTH to predict; MOVE + JUSTICE to escape

special: A pre-spice mass erupts from below in a fountain of sand and orange dust. Fortune and danger in one breath.
notes: Leaves a rich spice field — and calls every worm within reach. Harvesters race the clock.

name: Coriolis Storm

stats.test: MOVE + FAITH to find shelter; DISCIPLINE to endure

special: A wall of wind and grit that can strip paint, flesh and ornithopters from the sky.
tactics: Every round in the open inflicts Stress; communications fail.

effects.text: Radio and sensors fail for the duration

notes: Anyone caught in the open gains the exposed condition.

name: Fremen Fedaykin

stats.test: BATTLE + DUTY or COMMUNICATE + FAITH to parley

signatureAttacks.name: Out of the Sand
signatureAttacks.text: Ambush: +1 Difficulty to the first defense.

special: Death commandos of a sietch. They move unseen across open sand and strike before you know they are there.
tactics: Ambush from the sand, strike, vanish.
notes: Will honor a properly made challenge or a water bond.

name: Bene Gesserit Sister

stats.test: DISCIPLINE + FAITH to resist; COMMUNICATE + TRUTH to deceive

signatureAttacks.name: Voice
signatureAttacks.text: One untrained target obeys a single command.

signatureAttacks.name: Weirding Strike
signatureAttacks.text: 3 Stress and the target is SHAKEN.

special: A Sister on the order’s business. She sees through most lies and can command with a word.
tactics: Voice, then misdirection, then terrifying close combat.

effects.text: Characters without training who hear her Voice must pass DISCIPLINE (D2) or obey one command

notes: Her goals are the order’s, not her host’s.

name: Twisted Mentat
special: A Mentat whose conditioning has been bent toward murder and plots within plots.
tactics: Never attacks directly; arranges for others to.
notes: Every scene he is active, the Narrator may spend 1 Threat to reveal a prepared trap.

name: Guild Agent
special: A quiet representative of the Spacing Guild. Never violent — never needs to be.
tactics: Raises prices, delays ships, withdraws passage.
notes: Opposing the Guild costs the House rather than the character: spend Threat to cut off transport.

name: Face Dancer
special: A shapeshifting infiltrator who can wear anyone’s face and voice.
tactics: Replaces a trusted NPC, then waits.
notes: Truthsayers and dogs sometimes sense the wrongness.

name: Laza Tiger

stats.test: MOVE + JUSTICE to escape; BATTLE + DUTY to fight

signatureAttacks.name: Pounce
signatureAttacks.text: 4 Stress and the target is knocked prone.

special: A lean striped predator bred for hunting people. Often starved before release.
tactics: Hunts in pairs; goes for the weakest.
notes: A handler with a control pad may be nearby.

name: Salusan Bull

signatureAttacks.name: Charge
signatureAttacks.text: 5 Stress to one target in its line.

signatureAttacks.name: Trample
signatureAttacks.text: 3 Stress to everyone in its zone.

special: A huge, horned bull from a prison world. Kept for the arena and for ceremonies of strength.
tactics: Charges in straight lines; turning it is the trick.
notes: Killing one in the arena earns enormous honor.

name: Sandtrout Swarm
special: Leathery creatures that wrap around water and seal it away underground.
tactics: Smothers any open water within reach.
notes: Children of the sietch catch them as a game. A sealed cache may be lost to them.

name: Desert Raiders
special: Desperate outcasts who prey on prospectors and caravans for water and spice.
tactics: Hit and run from rock ridges.
notes: They can be bought off with water.

name: Smuggler Crew
special: A crawler crew running spice past the tariff lines.
tactics: Avoids fights; trades information for safe passage.
